DJ-41 PRO II — CONTROL MAP

The physical layout stays clean. Yellow labels use SHIFT. Pink A–F labels use ALPHA. Use the arrow pad to move through your expression and calculation history.

SHIFT + RCL Store the current value in memory
RCL Recall memory M
M+ Add the current value to memory
SHIFT + M+ Subtract the current value from memory
SHIFT + sin / cos / tan Inverse trig
hyp + sin / cos / tan Hyperbolic trig
MODE Cycle DEG → RAD → GRAD
SHIFT + Ans Cycle angle mode
S⇔D Toggle decimal and fraction output
° ′ ″ Convert current answer to degrees-minutes-seconds
SHIFT + × / ÷ nPr / nCr templates
SHIFT + + / − Pol / Rec templates
SHIFT + ×10ˣ π
ALPHA + ×10ˣ e
SHIFT + . Random number
SHIFT + 0 Round template
SHIFT + DEL Toggle overwrite mode
SHIFT + AC Power off; press ON to wake
Keyboard Digits, operators, Enter, Backspace and arrows work
Keyboard shortcuts Q √ · S sin · C cos · T tan · L log · N ln · P π · ! factorial · ? help
